name: Blood City Limits
source:
"Do you think... we can change it? The world?"

Mabel awakens to a broken, pulsating shadow of a world. Alone.

A feeling in her gut knows she needs to find something. Something, or someone.

Under the blood-red sky, she begins her search for answers. As she walks the cracked streets and twisted paths, she can only hope to find someone to go through this with.

No one wants to go through the end of the world alone.‎

translation:
“你认为……我们可以改变这个世界吗？”

梅布尔醒来时发现了一个破碎的、脉动的世界阴影。独自的。

她的直觉知道她需要找到一些东西。某事，或某人。

血红的天空下，她开始寻找答案。当她走在龟裂的街道和曲折的小路上时，她只希望能找到一个可以一起经历这一切的人。

没有人愿意独自经历世界末日。‎ 

[来自[url=https://swampsnail.itch.io/blood-city-limits]Itch.io[/url]]
